integrity: All exact asymptotic and conditional claims supported by a self-contained proof. Included independent numerical quadratures and FFT checks are finite and not a proof of the limiting statements. Independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive Type-I Pareto reset parameters, one-dimensional free Brownian motion, absorbing point and independent restart at a fixed position; nonuniformity at large shape indices; no finite-time crossover bound. Existing general restart renewal identity and mean-moment criterion are credited as prior results.
title: Algebraic first-passage tails and geometric–Rayleigh survivor selection under Pareto resetting
